---
name: sequence_alignment
description: Domain knowledge for short-read alignment and post-alignment processing.
---

# Sequence Alignment

Domain knowledge for aligning short reads to a reference genome and
processing the resulting alignments.

## Expected Workflow

1. Check the dataset and assay facts first:
   - read layout
   - assay type
   - reference genome and index
   - whether downstream steps depend on pairing semantics
2. Choose an aligner and mode that match the assay instead of reusing a
   familiar default blindly.
3. Treat mapping rate and summary statistics as a sanity check on the
   reference and alignment mode.
4. Apply post-alignment filters deliberately and document what each one
   removes.
5. Accept the alignment branch only if sort order, indexing, and summary
   files all match the delivered BAM.

## Alignment Basics

- **Aligner choice matters**: Different aligners (Bowtie2, BWA, minimap2,
  HISAT2, STAR) have different sensitivity, speed, and intended use

/usr/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail
printf '%s\\n' '--- final files ---'
find final_answer -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\\n' | sort
printf '%s\\n' '--- method ---'
jq -e 'keys == [\"aligner\"] and .aligner == \"BWA-MEM\"' final_answer/method.json >/dev/null && jq . final_answer/method.json
printf '%s\\n' '--- FASTQ structural checks ---'
for f in final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz; do
  gzip -t \""'$f"
  lines=$(gzip -cd "$f" | awk '"'END{print NR}')
  records="'$((lines / 4))
  remainder=$((lines % 4))
  lengths=$(gzip -cd "$f" | awk '"'NR%4==2{s=length("'$0)} NR%4==0{if(s!=length($0)){bad++}} END{print bad+0}'"')
  printf '%s records=%s lines_mod_4=%s seq_qual_length_mismatches=%s\\n' \""'$f" "$records" "$remainder" "$lengths"
done
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- mate synchronization ---'
paste <(gzip -cd final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz | awk 'NR%4==1{h="'$0; sub(/''^@/,"",h); sub(/[[:space:]]+.*/,"",h); sub(/'"\\/[12]"'$/,"",h); print h}'"') <(gzip -cd final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz | awk 'NR%4==1{h="'$0; sub(/''^@/,"",h); sub(/[[:space:]]+.*/,"",h); sub(/'"\\/[12]"'$/,"",h); print h}'"') | awk '"'$1!=$2{bad++} END{print "header_order_mismatches",bad+0}'"'
printf '%s\\n' '--- sequence/quality preservation against provided inputs ---'
for pair in forward reverse; do
  if [ \""'$pair" = forward ]; then src=data/inputs/short_reads/pair/forward/forward.fastqsanger.gz; out=final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz; else src=data/inputs/short_reads/pair/reverse/reverse.fastqsanger.gz; out=final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz; fi
  missing=$(comm -23 <(gzip -cd "$out" | awk '"'NR%4==2{s="'$0} NR%4==0{print s "'"\\t\" "'$0}'"' | sort) <(gzip -cd \""'$src" | awk '"'NR%4==2{s="'$0} NR%4==0{print s "'"\\t\" "'$0}'"' | sort) | wc -l)
  printf '%s output_records_not_found_in_source=%s\\n' \""'$pair" "$missing"
done
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- checksums ---'
sha256sum final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz final_answer/method.json"
